title: Coordinate-dependent signals versus spacetime invariants
objective: Conduct a compact research program that determines which apparently nonzero geometric quantities in flat spacetime are coordinate artifacts and which calculations provide coordinate-invariant evidence. Compare at least two nontrivial coordinate descriptions, actively search for a misleading component-level argument, and build a reproducible hierarchy of checks that would prevent a client from confusing connection coefficients with curvature.
success_definition: The trajectory must move beyond confirming one known zero. It should expose at least one plausible but false inference, test it, recover with an invariant criterion, state coordinate-domain assumptions, and deliver mutually reinforcing symbolic or formal evidence.
deliverables: A tested hypothesis chain containing both a refutation and a validated invariant statement.
Executable curvature evidence in at least two coordinate descriptions.
An explicit map from coordinate-dependent quantities to invariant conclusions.
A short reusable validation protocol with assumptions and failure modes.
preferred_validators: Lean 4 for a small aggregation implication when useful
resources: Optional GR_python package, resolved through ASTRA_GR_PYTHON_ROOT
linear_control_directions: Compute Christoffel symbols for Minkowski spacetime in spherical coordinates.
Compute the Ricci scalar for Minkowski spacetime in spherical coordinates.
Repeat the Ricci scalar calculation in cylindrical coordinates.
Check selected Riemann tensor components in spherical coordinates.
List the coordinate singularities of the chosen charts.
Compare component-level and scalar curvature evidence.
Construct a small formal implication from zero tensor components to zero trace.
Summarize a reusable flat-spacetime validation checklist.

expert_anchors.goal_advancement: How completely the work separates coordinate artifacts from invariant conclusions across the full objective.
expert_anchors.hypothesis_quality: Whether hypotheses are falsifiable and include a genuinely misleading component-level alternative rather than only safe confirmations.
expert_anchors.research_depth: Whether evidence from one cycle changes, sharpens, or generalizes later cycles into a coherent hierarchy.
expert_anchors.evidence_quality: Strength and independence of curvature checks, domains, residuals, and any cross-engine agreement.
expert_anchors.self_correction: Whether the trajectory recognizes and repairs an invalid inference about nonzero connection coefficients or chart singularities.
expert_anchors.cross_perspective_uptake: Whether a non-dominant model contributes a decisive invariant, counterexample, assumption, or validation method that later work actually uses.
expert_anchors.novelty_utility: Usefulness of the resulting audit protocol for preventing real GR validation errors, even if the underlying geometry is known.
expert_anchors.artifact_reproducibility: Whether code, engine metadata, assumptions, and outputs are sufficient for an independent rerun.
